item.title: 【Requests】[REQ VID] - Henry Danger Specials One-Part Versions
item.description:
Hello, is it possible if anyone could please upload these Henry Danger two-parter episodes in the form of their official one-parter variants? Preferably English, subtitled

  • Henry and the Bad Girl (Season 1, prod 998, episodes 24-25)
  • One Henry, Three Girls (Season 2, prod 997, episodes 2-3)
  • Indestructible Henry (Season 2, prod 996, episodes 10-11)
  • Space Invaders (Season 3, prod 993, episodes 9-10)
  • Live & Dangerous (Season 3, prod 992, episodes 18-20)
  • Back to the Danger (Season 4, prod 990, episodes 9-10)
  • A New Hero (Season 5, prod 888, episodes 6-8)
  • Sister Twister (Season 5, prod 896, episodes 23-24)
